bullets: Built a Docker-isolated pipeline that verifies LLM-generated SWE-bench Verified patches with regression, static and pre-frozen reproduction tests in network-disabled containers; over 100 tasks, accepted patches were correct 87% of the time (47/54).

Halted the study when a pre-registered audit caught environment leakage in 8 of 50 tasks from package copies baked into prebuilt images; added container masking and integrity checks, then reran all 100 tasks.

Rebuilt test execution with per-module isolation, retries and time budgets, raising conclusive verdicts from 31 to 58 of 83 tasks (95% of 37.6K selected test runs now return a result), backed by 1,100+ unit tests.

Productionized visual inspection for a Magna Seating plant in Spain, deploying YOLOX + NanoSAM + PatchCore with ONNX, TensorRT FP16, Docker and NVIDIA Triton on Jetson AGX Orin at ~300 ms latency and 100% defect recall.
Projected ~$700K/year in labor savings with a lens-debris inspection pipeline (100% recall, 96% precision), handed off to the plant.

Projected up to $7M/year in labor savings with a multi-camera stamped-part inspection PoC: built registration and cross-camera deduplication, proved it on 2- and 4-camera rigs, and handed it off with a path to 6- and 24-camera deployments.
Saved 1,000+ engineer-hours/year in regulated documentation as the sole developer on a 6-person team, shipping 4 production LLM tools on Azure Kubernetes Service.
Cut incident misclassification by ~40% with a real-time SQL-backed analytics workflow, Plotly dashboards and Excel reporting.

Integrated LiDAR and thermal sensors over Arduino and I2C for real-time range and thermal telemetry in onboard perception.
